user.title: Epson projector over ESC/VP21
user.description: Connect to the serial-to-TCP bridge wired to the projector's RS-232C port. The projector can be off; its serial number is picked up the next time it is on.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the serial-to-TCP bridge.
data_description.port: TCP port of the bridge (TCP Server mode).
data_description.name: Name for the projector device.

error.no_response: Connected, but the projector did not answer PWR?. Check the cable, baud rate (9600 8N1) and that the bridge is in transparent mode.

data_description.scan_interval: How often PWR? is polled, in seconds. Other values are read on the same cycle while the projector is on.

projector_busy.message: The projector is warming up or cooling down and ignores commands. Try again shortly.

entry_not_found.message: No loaded Epson ESC/VP21 entry with ID {entry_id}.

entry_required.message: More than one (or no) projector is set up; pass config_entry_id.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends a raw ESC/VP21 command (for example PWR? or SOURCE 30) and returns the projector's reply.

config_entry_id.name: Projector
config_entry_id.description: Projector to send to. Optional when only one is set up.

command.name: Command
command.description: ESC/VP21 command without the trailing carriage return. Commands ending in ? are queries.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the reply.
